انبثقوا (form VII)
# اِنْبَثَقُوا (inbaṯaqū) /in.ba.θa.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
# اِنْبَثِقُوا (inbaṯiqū) /in.ba.θi.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْبَثَقَ (inbaṯaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
